def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}

def upscale(grid, factor):

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):

import json
G=load()
inp2,out2=G['Demo pair 2 input'],G['Demo pair 2 output']

def f(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # background = most common color
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for r in grid for v in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    L=[i for i,r in enumerate(grid) if 2 in r][0]
    cells=[(i,j,grid[i][j]) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] not in (bg,2)]
    if not cells: return [r[:] for r in grid]
    rows=sorted({i for i,_,_ in cells})
    obj=[[grid[i][j] if (i,j) in {(a,b) for a,b,_ in cells} else None for j in range(w)] for i in rows]
    side = 1 if rows[0] > L else -1
    # place object adjacent to line
    height=len(rows)
    newtop = L+1 if side==1 else L-height
    outg=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h): outg[r][:]=[grid[r][j] if grid[r][j]==2 else bg for j in range(w)]
    for k,i in enumerate(rows):
        for j in range(w):
            if obj[k][j] is not None: outg[newtop+k][j]=obj[k][j]
    # 8-line adjacent on far side
    line8 = newtop+height if side==1 else newtop-1
    outg[line8]=[8]*w
    return outg

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2']:
    i,o=G[k+' input'],G[k+' output']
    print(k, f(i)==o)
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
